policy: Every quantitative claim identifies its source, evidence tier, and interpretation boundary. Reconstructed graphics are not presented as rerun experiments.

claims.claim: 114/114 episodes accepted; ~125 episodes/hour; 337,420 messages; zero dropped messages and SHA mismatches
claims.source: Uploaded robot-learning research update; controlled simulation-cell collection session
claims.boundary: single session; not a policy-success result

claims.claim: 47 pass, 58 warn, 9 fail initial QC verdicts; all nine failures traced to a gripper-command rate-check false positive
claims.source: Uploaded research update and collection record

claims.claim: ACT 18.5 ms median warm inference; compact VLA 142.7 ms on RTX 6000 Ada
claims.source: Uploaded training log index and server stress measurements
claims.boundary: one hardware configuration; loopback, not live control latency

claims.claim: 0.0164 rad offline action MAE and 0/5 closed-loop success
512 kinematic configurations with zero flange disagreement; 68/68 scenes compiled; worst composition deviation 0.000715 mm; 705 tests passed on one clean rebuild
claims.boundary: geometry and software parity do not establish visual or contact parity

claims.claim: Multi-view F1 0.82 versus single-view F1 0.76 under occlusion
UR Fall GCN+Transformer F1 0.9033; cross-view and structured occlusion results
Mean DTW 0.62–1.65 m across reported target, query, platform and obstruction cases
claims.source: TAR project report Table 1 and arXiv:2405.11655
claims.boundary: system-level metric; does not isolate subsystem error

claims.claim: Two-robot leader following, obstacle-triggered coordinated stop and automatic resume demonstrated
claims.boundary: no repeated-trial latency or formation-error benchmark

claims.claim: 32.27% relative success-rate increase; 0.45 lower average Contact Factor; 58 s lower average execution time
claims.boundary: comparison conditions from the paper; not universal estimates

claims.claim: 72% scalar-loss baseline; up to 98% vector-based multimodal accuracy; 97% with 92 training samples
claims.boundary: one platform and bounded attack library
